sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay of Eutagora revolves around maintaining your balance on a circular platform while dodging approaching geometric figures. The game features a variety of shapes, each with its own speed, size, and difficulty level. As you progress through the game, the figures will increase in speed and complexity, requiring you to be quick and agile to avoid them.

To control your character, you can use the mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. The control mechanism is designed to be intuitive, allowing you to easily move left, right, up, or down. You can also jump using the space bar or the jump button on your keyboard or touchscreen. It's essential to time your jumps carefully, as missing a jump can result in a game over.

One of the most challenging aspects of Eutagora is the limited space on the circular platform. This requires players to be strategic in their movements, often having to wait for the perfect moment to jump or dodge an approaching figure. The game's difficulty level increases gradually, making it an excellent choice for players who want to improve their reaction time and spatial awareness.
